title: A Bell for the Visitor
author: Xanthe Marchetti
blurb: Felix Reyes, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
